title: Lamine Yamal x Coca-Cola - World Cup
description: My job was to create a 3D stadium, with Coca-Cola references.

images.alt: Blender viewport clay view of the full 3D stadium model from above, with crowd-filled stands around the pitch
Grey clay viewport shot from pitch level: packed two-tier stands, roof trusses and photographers along the touchline
Clay viewport close-up of the lower stand, fans waving flags under the curved upper tier and roof structure
Untextured crowd close-up in the Blender viewport, rows of 3D fans raising their arms in the stands
Rendered viewport from inside the crowd: fans in red-and-black scarves cheer under a 0-0 scoreboard
Shaded viewport of the stadium bowl in daylight, red-and-black flags across both tiers and the pitch below
Top-down shaded view of the stadium: white roof ring around stands full of red fans and the green pitch
Lit viewport shot of the lower tier, fans waving Coca-Cola and red-and-black flags beneath branded LED boards
